title: fix(cli): send supported MIME types for OPUS and MKV inputs
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16345

- Maps `.opus` to `audio/ogg` and `.mkv` to `video/x-matroska` in the shared CLI MIME helper so supported audio inputs pass the service gate.
- Extends existing isolation/voice-change tests with native multipart serialization, uppercase extensions, filename/payload checks, and existing-format/unknown-file controls.
- Six regressions fail before the fix; all 18 focused tests and 288 CLI tests pass afterward. Build, Biome and independent focused review pass; strict TypeScript retains main's 36 diagnostics. Used installed Vitest 2.1.9.
- No server changes or live provider decoding; the unchanged service gate was checked locally. No Pollen used.

gist.headline: The MIME finally fits
gist.blurb: Two familiar audio inputs get the labels the service expects. The CLI can send .opus and .mkv files through the gate without changing the gatekeeper.
gist.summary: The Polli CLI maps .opus files to audio/ogg and .mkv files to video/x-matroska, allowing supported isolation and voice-change inputs to pass the existing service MIME gate.
gist.impact: CLI requests with .opus or .mkv inputs get the supported MIME types in their multipart uploads; server behavior and provider decoding remain unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli at a cozy retro terminal attaching the correct MIME labels to .opus and .mkv file parcels before they pass through a small garden gate. A helpful CRT monitor robot checks the labels; code-plants and lime-green flowers make the gate feel friendly rather than forbidding.
